body:
# 🟩🟥 RedAndGreen — The Ultimate Survival Thriller

> **"Green light, run. Red light, freeze. One wrong step, you're history."**

RedAndGreen is a lightweight, highly optimized, and feature-rich Minecraft plugin inspired by the legendary "Squid Game" mechanics. Designed from scratch for modern server networks, it delivers a flawless, lag-free minigame experience with unique combat twists and total customization.

---

## ⚡ Key Features

* **🚫 Smart Anti-False Flag:** Our movement detection engine strictly tracks coordinate changes and completely ignores head rotations (mouse looks). No more unfair deaths just because a player looked around!
* **⚔️ Backstab PvP Twist:** A unique combat mechanic! Players can instantly eliminate opponents by hitting them from behind during the green light phase. 
* **🏹 Elite Guard Archers:** When a player fails, custom guard arrows rain down on them with configurable miss rates and realistic sound effects.
* **📊 Dynamic Scoreboards:** Sleek, flicker-free sidebars that update in real-time, showing live game states, remaining time, and the current light color.
* **⚙️ 100% Standalone:** Zero dependencies required. Just drop it into your plugins folder and start creating arenas.

---

## 🌍 Cross-Play & Bedrock Support (GeyserMC)

🎉 **Fully Tested & Compatible!** RedAndGreen is built using clean, packet-safe Spigot APIs, meaning it works flawlessly with **GeyserMC**. 
* Bedrock Edition players (Mobile, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, Windows 10) can enjoy the exact same experience.
* Titles, action bars, scoreboards, and movement tracking display perfectly on all Bedrock clients with zero glitches.

---

## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions

### Player Commands
* `/rag join <arena>` — Join an active game lobby.
* `/rag leave` — Safely leave the current game.
* `/rag help` — Show the help menu.

### Admin Commands (`rag.admin`)
* `/rag create <name>` — Create a new arena instance.
* `/rag setlobby` — Set the main waiting lobby location.
* `/rag setreturn` — Set the exit location for winners and losers.
* `/rag <arena> setspawn` — Set the starting line for the arena.
* `/rag <arena> setdeathzone` — Set the boundaries (`pos1`/`pos2`) where movement is tracked.
* `/rag <arena> setwinzone` — Set the finish line boundaries (`pos1`/`pos2`).
* `/rag <arena> time <seconds>` — Customize the round duration.
* `/rag reload` — Hot-reload configurations without restarting the server.

---

## 📦 Technical Specifications

* **Supported Versions:** Minecraft 1.20, 1.20.x, 1.21+
* **Java Runtime:** Java 17 / Java 21+
* **Performance:** 0% TPS impact. Built using modern, leak-proof asynchronous tasks.

---

## 🚀 Quick Setup Guide

1. Download the `RedAndGreen.jar` file and drop it into your server's `/plugins/` directory.
2. Restart or start your server to generate the configuration files.
3. Stand at your global lobby spot and type `/rag setlobby`, then define the exit spot with `/rag setreturn`.
4. Create an arena using `/rag create game1`.
5. Stand at the starting line and type `/rag game1 setspawn`.
6. Use a wooden axe (or look at corners) to set the **Death Zone** (where players run) and **Win Zone** (the finish line) using `/rag game1 setdeathzone pos1/pos2` and `/rag game1 setwinzone pos1/pos2`.
7. Invite your players and let the deadly games begin!
8. For help with this plugin, first register here https://gemini.google.com/gem/1N7r_cRKYKj7HdCe8nIG0OVjBZ7gnUpL1?usp=sharing and then reopen the link.
